title: Simple Broadcast
description: This mod adds a simple broadcast command with some customization.
body:
This is a simple mod that adds a couple commands connected to broadcasting messages.

## Commands:
```/broadcast``` Plain broadcast command, just add the message and you are done!
```/broadcastconfigauth``` Configure the author name color and name itself. 
```/broadcastconfigmsg``` Configure message color.

## Important!!!
After installing the mod, use both of the config commands, otherwise quotation marks may appear in your broadcast.
If you find any issues, dm @susradist on discord
